# content.md output

Save the exact, unedited `content.md` result here as `candidate.json`.

The committed `review-request.json` translates the frozen scenario into the
current deterministic UX-writing review contract. Its generated `review.json`
and `repair-brief.json` record what the shipped evaluator diagnosed before
candidate generation.

Do not hand-author or repair the saved output. Record the exact tool version and
run identifier when available. If generation fails, save a separate
`run-error.json`; do not manufacture a candidate.
